evidence.statement: A real read-only all-configuration read returned 295 response-payload bytes including the two-byte positive-response header; 293 bytes are configuration data. The 295-byte payload decodes to 462 definition fields. The raw record, its hash, and the individual raw values remain private.
evidence.hardware_scope: 231A07278R / EMM-T4 L4; MCU and executable firmware unconfirmed
evidence.software_scope: EMM_EDISON_DDT2000_SW13_1_V1_3 (definition selected by 8/414/C132/4022); executable firmware unknown
evidence.measurement_ref: Phase 6.7 real read-only measurement; raw record and hash kept private.
evidence.residual_uncertainty: 295 bytes are the response payload including the positive-response header; 293 bytes are configuration data. The record is a configuration snapshot, not firmware.

evidence.statement: The cornering configuration flag is 0 in both the single-flag read and the all-configuration record. That is a value observation, not a function test.
evidence.measurement_ref: Phase 6.7 real read-only measurement; raw record private.
evidence.residual_uncertainty: Flag value 0; the cornering light was not tested.

evidence.statement: The front-fog configuration flag is 1 and the PWM configuration is active (the without-PWM flag is 0). The owner reports that front fog lamps are installed; their electrical function is not proven.
evidence.hardware_scope: 231A07278R / EMM-T4 L4; front fog lamp hardware owner-reported
evidence.measurement_ref: Phase 6.7 real read-only measurement; raw record private.
evidence.residual_uncertainty: Configuration only; no lamp function test.

evidence.statement: The real record contains cornering parameters A1 = 60 degrees, A2 = 15 degrees, speed threshold = 40 km/h, and dimming raw value 220. The 2.2-second interpretation is only plausible at 0.01 s/LSB; the definition says 0.1 s/LSB.
evidence.measurement_ref: Phase 6.7 real read-only measurement; raw record private.
evidence.residual_uncertainty: Dimming scale is unresolved; the physical function is not tested.

evidence.statement: Twenty fields in the record lie outside their documented ranges: zero are proven definition errors, 14 are probable scaling or offset errors, and 6 remain unresolved contradictions. Raw values were not corrected.
evidence.residual_uncertainty: The category counts are analysis results, not corrected values.

evidence.statement: V4 to V5 regression: 54 rows and 33 shared columns, zero known V4 values lost, 62 expected changes. Android Auto and MirrorLink retain menu-visible = yes; V5's narrative claim that menu visibility is everywhere unknown is false. V5.1 adds an explicit provenance column without changing technical values.
evidence.hardware_scope: Smart 453 head-unit rows in the matrix; EMM rows as marked
evidence.software_scope: V4, V5 and V5.1 matrices; head-unit MFD rows unchanged
evidence.residual_uncertainty: The V5.1 provenance column is documentation, not a new measurement.

evidence.statement: The single-flag write definition uses a fixed value with no read-modify-write; it has no explicit save, commit or reset field. It was not executed. The all-configuration write is denied in the after-sales session and is not a safe fallback.
evidence.residual_uncertainty: Definition only; session, persistence and side effects are untested.

evidence.statement: Persistence across an ignition cycle, whether the all-configuration record reflects a single-flag write, the rollback path, and the electrical lamp function are unproven. No write was performed.
evidence.residual_uncertainty: Everything about a future write remains a hypothesis; no write or function test was done.
